title: After dark
steps: Deep night in the castle. The fire is low and everyone is asleep. Then, a very soft knock at the common room's door. You sit up in bed.
The two of you tiptoe across the common room to the door, and you open it.

I could not sleep. Today in the library I was looking for books about this castle, and inside the one I took I found something folded: the naughty child's map. I think a pupil who slipped out at night drew it years ago. In the corner it has a word, *orvim*. I think it is a spell to make it work. Take it, maybe you can figure out how to do it.
Why were you looking for books about the castle?

The older pupils say the passages change at night, and that Dask patrols them so that no one is out of bed. There are also rumours that strange things happen in those corridors, or that voices are heard.

That is why I think we should go investigate... And, if that map works as I think it does, it will help us find our way in the passages, even in the dark. It is best if we look at it before every step we take at night in the castle. What do you say, are you coming with me?
Not sure... all right, let's go. But if Dask sees us, straight back to bed.
The three of you slip out into the corridor. The stone is cold under your bare feet, and {friend} goes first.
